They are caught only by the fixed-world identity tests in test_galaxy_map (ui rc=2). Suggest cross-checking overlapping context fields (clock.*, tick, journey.plan.*) against view.

client.map.empty is appended to every copy-only sentence (title 'Select a star', subtitle empty, coverage unavailable, etc.): structurally satisfies 'binding has a field' and the missing-field check, but asserts nothing about the text. Acceptable as copy-only, but it is a presence loophole; the real protection is the identity fixture.
